title: Navimower Map Card 0.3.6-beta23

## Frontend privacy and interoperability cleanup

This prerelease aligns the Map Card's current public documentation with the privacy/interoperability wording used by the Navimower integration. It intentionally does not change mower, map, scheduler, notification, Gate-area or underlay runtime behavior from beta22.

### Changed

- Reword current architecture documentation around the Home Assistant/Navimower frontend-backend boundary instead of describing private-cloud implementation details.
- Clarify that Navimow account credentials, account session tokens and map-provider secrets remain backend-owned and are not Map Card configuration.
- Clarify Google Satellite handling: the card receives authenticated Home Assistant backend paths/availability metadata; the Google API key and provider session token are not exposed to card JavaScript.
- Replace stale/private-cloud terminology in Gate-area safety documentation with neutral cloud-fallback wording.
- Use neutral integration/mower-backend terminology for scheduler and action responsibility boundaries.
- Add a regression test that prevents protocol-provenance wording such as `private-cloud`, `reverse engineering`, `captured live` and `proven live` from returning to the active public frontend documentation.

### Unchanged

- Historical `CHANGELOG.md` and older release notes remain historical records and are not rewritten.
- Existing screenshots/images and Navimower branding are unchanged.
- The Map Card remains a frontend only; mower commands, schedules, notifications, georeference, Gate occupancy and provider secrets remain integration/backend responsibilities.
- Multi mower, current-cycle/History rendering, notifications, Schedule, Gate-area editing and map underlay behavior are unchanged from beta22.

### Compatibility

- Use the latest Navimower 0.4.4 beta for the complete current Map Card 0.3.6 feature set.
- Basic 0.3.5-era Single mower behavior remains compatible with Navimower 0.4.3+, while newer 0.3.6 features retain their documented integration capability boundaries.
